resources.string: Could not complete this change. Please try again.
This item changed elsewhere. Close and reopen it to use the latest version.
Review notification text and save an entry yourself. Your enabled templates can prepare drafts; saving always needs your confirmation.
Android notification access is not granted
Notification text stays locally for up to 7 days, 1,000 items or 10 MiB, whichever comes first. Saved ledger entries are kept separately.
Notification intake is busy. Try refreshing again.
Could not complete capture. Your saved entries remain available.
Android notification access settings could not be opened.
This app is ignored. Restore it in Settings → Notification sources, or select Ignored to see retained items.
No retained notifications match these filters.
Enable capture to retain notifications from other apps. You can always add an entry manually.
Connect Android notification access to capture new or currently active notifications.
No retained notifications yet. Refresh checks currently active notifications; cleared historical notifications cannot be retrieved.
Retain notification text on this device?

MoneyFly can read visible notifications from all other apps, including personal messages, and retain their title and text locally. Text is kept for up to 7 days, 1,000 items or 10 MiB, whichever comes first. Saved ledger entries remain separately. Android notification access is a separate permission granted on the next screen. Refresh can read currently active notifications, not cleared history. You can pause capture or ignore apps at any time. Parsing source switches do not limit this all-app Inbox.
Ignore %1$s in the current and future MoneyFly Inbox. Saved ledger entries and Android notifications stay in place. Restore this app in Settings → Notification sources.
The linked entry is no longer available.
The saved entry was deleted. Reposted notifications will not recreate it.
This app updated or reused its notification. Review this purchase before recording it separately.
A related notification already has an entry. Review the candidates before recording another purchase.
Notification text has expired. The saved or ignored outcome is retained.
No visible title or body was provided.
This is a notification group summary.

Ignored apps stop contributing to the Inbox. Restoring an app keeps individually ignored items ignored. Parsing switches control your enabled templates; they do not restrict all-app capture. Existing entries stay unchanged.
Sources appear after notifications are captured.
No Ready drafts match. You can record any unrecognized notification manually or teach a template.
Saving enables this template for %1$s and records clear matches in retained and future notifications.
Teach this app\'s format using text in this notification. Choose the fields below and preview changing purchases. A template is optional for recording an entry.
Type or paste the exact observed value. Each selected value must occur once in its chosen field; overlapping or ambiguous selections need correction.
Always this merchant, restricted to matching text
This merchant must appear literally in the chosen field. The template will require that merchant text and its word boundaries.
Optional: select reference or account text that changes between notifications, so it does not become a fixed part of the format. Leave blank when absent.

An account hint is variable message text, not an account binding. Choose an account manually in the entry. Date/time still defaults to notification posting time; this template does not parse transaction dates.
Use an explicitly confirmed currency assumption
Read a currency token in each message
I confirm this currency assumption for all matches of this template.
I confirm the observed token maps to this currency, including any ambiguous symbol.
Each selected notification field must match its whole format. The source app and direction are fixed; date and optional account remain editable in each draft. No account is required.
Preview passed. Review the generated examples before enabling.
Preview needs changes. You can still record the entry manually.

Saving enables this template and parsing for this app. Clear matches in all retained pending messages and future notifications are recorded automatically. Ambiguous matches and possible duplicates stay in Inbox for review. Existing entries stay unchanged.
Enter a name, confirm currency, and choose unique, nonoverlapping amount and merchant text from the selected fields.
Could not save the template. It may have changed; check Settings before retrying.
Save was interrupted. Tap Save template to retry the same change, or cancel and check Settings before starting another template.
Enabled templates automatically record new clear matches. Use Apply to existing messages to run one template over retained notifications.
Create a template from a retained notification in the Inbox.

Apply “%1$s” to all retained, unrecorded messages from this app, including older notifications. Clear matches will be recorded now. Possible duplicates and unclear matches remain in Inbox for review. Saved or ignored messages are skipped.
Future notifications will no longer use this template. Saved ledger entries remain unchanged.
HKD is your manual default, not a currency detected from this notification. Confirm or change it before saving.
Choose a valid date range, using YYYY-MM-DD.
No entries match these filters. Try Clear all.
This time comes from the notification or capture, and may differ from the transaction time.
Check the amount, currency and date, then try again.
Save was interrupted. Tap Save to retry the same change, or Cancel and reopen to check its status.
You can undo this change from the message that follows.
A personal journal stored on this device. Account labels need no bank login or balance.
Nothing here yet. Add a label when you need one.
Higher priority wins. Matching rules suggest a category in the entry form. Equal-priority conflicts ask you to choose. Existing entries stay as recorded.
Deleting a label preserves saved entries. Category rules that use a deleted category are also removed.
Saved display name: %1$s. The original merchant text is kept.
Rules disagree: %1$s. Choose a category, or save as Uncategorized.
Other templates for this app: %1$d. Different formats are supported. Automatic recognition asks for review only when matching templates disagree. Identical copies do not record extra entries.
Each field matches its whole pattern. Text in braces is extracted or allowed to vary; the surrounding text must match exactly. You can select and copy these patterns.
Currency is explicitly present in the matched format.
